groups.title: Your AI,
groups.subtitle: 100% local, completely free. Bring your own CLI and keep full control over your data and workflows.

features.title: 100% Local & Private
features.description: All data stays on your machine. No third-party APIs, no data collection, no subscriptions. Completely free.

features.title: Bring Your Own CLI
features.description: Use Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Codex CLI, or local models via LM Studio and Ollama. We're a free wrapper for your existing tools.

features.title: No Vendor Lock-In
features.description: Switch between CLIs anytime. Your workflows, agents, and data stay with you. Not locked to any single provider or ecosystem.

groups.title: Organize,
groups.subtitle: Powerful tools to manage AI agents like a real team. Tickets, boards, and custom agents working together.

features.title: Ticket & Kanban
features.description: Track work across agents with a powerful ticket system. Link conversations to tickets and see the full history of agent interactions.

features.title: Custom AI Agents
features.description: Create specialized agents with unique prompts, system instructions, and tool permissions. Each agent has its own personality and expertise.

features.title: Epic Organization
features.description: Group related tickets into epics for hierarchical organization. Perfect for tracking large research projects.

groups.title: Built for
groups.subtitle: Advanced capabilities for developers and researchers who need more than basic chat.

features.title: Agent Council
features.description: Let multiple AI personas collaborate on your prompts. Each agent brings a different perspective, debating and refining ideas to produce richer, more thoughtful responses.

features.title: MCP Tool Protocol
features.description: Connect agents to anything via MCP servers. Send Slack or Discord notifications, query databases, call external APIs, run browser automation, trigger webhooks. Combined with visual flows, the possibilities are endless.

features.title: Split Panel Previews
features.description: Preview anything side by side: Playwright browser, Markdown, HTML, images, Excalidraw diagrams, molecule structures, BibTeX references, and PRD documents. All synced with your code.

features.title: Agentic File Review
features.description: IDE-like view of all agent changes. Review every file modification in diff views, accept or reject changes individually, and maintain full control before anything reaches your codebase.

features.title: Multi-Session Chat
features.description: Run multiple conversation threads, fork sessions from any message, and organize chats with color-coded labels.

features.title: IDE Integration
features.description: Open files in your VS Code compatible IDE via our bridge extension, use the integrated VS Code web, or the Monaco editor for quick edits.

features.title: Visual Flow Editor
features.description: Design multi-agent pipelines with a node-based editor. Chain agents, add conditions, parallel execution, loops, and scheduled triggers.

groups.title: Enterprise
groups.subtitle: Audit trails, event-driven automation, and advanced thinking modes for professional workflows.

features.title: Git Graph Visualization
features.description: Interactive branch visualization with commit history. See your repository structure, compare branches, and navigate commits visually.

features.title: Command Runner & Server Detection
features.description: Run commands and see output in real-time. Auto-detects local servers and opens them in the split panel preview. No context switching needed.

features.title: Full Audit Trail
features.description: Every action is logged with actor information (human or agent). Never lose track of what happened and when.

features.title: Event-Driven Flows
features.description: Trigger workflows from ticket events, cron schedules, or manual actions. Build reactive automation systems.

features.title: Flow Debug Mode
features.description: Pause flows on errors, inspect state, fix issues, and resume execution. Debug complex multi-agent workflows without starting over.

features.title: Smart Notifications
features.description: Desktop and sound notifications for agent completions, errors, and important events.
